svg.text: Tapping the Fuhr multitronic bus without loading it
The bus sees a 147 k divider and nothing else — about 80 uA. The LED current comes from the lock supply, so the signal line is never the source.
ESP SIDE — 3.3 V domain, its own supply
Both GPIOs idle HIGH — the opto only conducts while the bus is driven high — so set inverted: true on each pin.
Never join lock GND to ESP GND: that separation is what keeps the tap passive and lets the ESP outlive a cut to the lock supply.
